values.note: Rates page: water & electric sites from $47 a night ($282 a week), full hookups from $55 ($330 a week), long-term full-hookup sites from $750 a month; primitive tent sites from $28. CampLife quoted $50 (water/electric) and $58 (full hookup) for one night on Tue 2027-06-08 and Sat 2027-06-12, before tax. Rates cover 2 adults, 4 children, 1 vehicle and 1 RV; extra adult $5, extra vehicle $5, extra tent $15 a night. Taxes extra.

fees.source: https://lazydaycampground.com/rates/ ('WATER & ELECTRIC SITES starting at $47 / night'; 'FULL HOOKUP RV SITE starting at $55 / night'; page (c) 2026) + CampLife /api/invoice/estimate, one night 2027-06-08: site 428135 resSubTotal 50, site 428232 resSubTotal 58 (Taxes 3.25 / 3.77), read 2026-11-06

values.note: CampLife sells 60 RV sites online (58 pull-through, 2 back-in; listed 30-45 ft), 5 tent sites and a guest house; the operator says '53+' full-hookup sites, plus water/electric sites and 6 primitive sites.

sites.source: CampLife booking session for campground 7124502 (siteMap: 58 'Pull Through', 2 'Back-in', 5 'Tent', 1 'Guest House'; site records maxLength 30-45) + https://lazydaycampground.com/ ('53+ FULL HOOKUP RV SITES', 'rigs up to 45 feet'), read 2026-11-06

values.note: Online on CampLife or by phone. Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends need 3 nights; 'Some 4th of July weekends and all October weekends require a 2-night minimum stay' (CampLife: 'There is a 2 night minimum stay for this period' for Sat 2026-10-17). Check-in 1-6 pm (Friday to 7, Sunday to 5); no new arrivals after dark. Cancel 7+ days out for a refund less the booking fee, 3-6 days out less one night, under 72 hours nothing; holiday and peak weekends 14 / 7-13 / under 7 days. Monthly sites by contact only.

booking.source: https://lazydaycampground.com/rates/ ('Holiday Weekend Reservations ... 3-night minimum stay ... all October weekends require a 2-night minimum stay'; CHECK IN times) + https://lazydaycampground.com/policies/ (Cancellation Policy) + https://lazydaycampground.com/faq/ (arrivals after dark) + CampLife availability 2026-10-17, read 2026-11-06

note: Wooded park 1.5 miles off I-70 at Montgomery City with a pool, mini golf, a fenced dog park and a small catch-and-release lake. --Claude
summary: Operator pages + CampLife API: confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups; added rates ($47 W/E from the rates page, $50/$58 engine quotes for June 2027), 66 online sites (60 RV, 30-45 ft), showers/laundry/store/wifi, CampLife booking URL, holiday 3-night and October-weekend 2-night minimums, cancellation terms. Note cleaned. Season unresolved (FAQ says seasonal, a page says year-round, CampLife shows no open sites in Oct 2026/Jan 2027). Lake under an acre.
flags: Price gate: cheapest RV night is the water/electric site - $47 'starting at' on the operator's 2026 rates page, $50.00 before tax on CampLife for Tue 2027-06-08 (site 428135, 30 ft); full hookups $55 / $58. At the line but not over; also a Good Sam Park (stored discounts.good_sam true), so 10% off gives ~$45. No gateway (St. Louis 115 km); family has not stayed.
Ratings: Google 4.8 / 822 (phone (573) 564-2949 matches); RV Life 5 stars from 500, $$ (avg_rate $40). Presence passes.

Long-stay tests (monthly $750 and seasonal sites marketed; 'popular choice for contract workers'): (1) $47-50 nightly - passes; (2) nightly rates on its own page and CampLife sells one night - passes; (3) only holiday 3-night and October-weekend 2-night minimums - passes; (4) CampLife showed 38 of 60 RV sites open for one night on Tue 2027-06-08 (39 on Sat 2027-06-12) - passes; (5) campground, no homes sold - passes. Not long-stay in character.

Season conflict, left unwritten: FAQ 'Lazy Day Campground operates seasonally ... Please check with us for current seasonal dates', but /open-year-round/ gives winter information for travellers 'year-round', and CampLife answered 200 with no open sites for 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26 and 2027-01-30 (closed, unreleased or full - not stated).
facilities.dump false (derived from old note prose) is not confirmed: no page read mentions a dump station either way; left as stored.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands: the catch-and-release lake is ~35 x 100 m (under an acre) in the woods ~150-200 m east of the nearest sites; a small fishing pond sits in the loops. Pin (entrance) is within ~150 m of the loops; no move.
